declare
 d_id varchar2(10);
 m_status varchar2(5);
 false_cnt number := 0;
begin
if :potential_duplicates.merge_flag not in ('PRIMR','NOMER','FALSE','SECON') then
 :potential_duplicates.merge_flag := '';
 show_error('16127'); /* invalid value for flag*/
 raise form_trigger_failure;
end if;



if :potential_duplicates.merge_flag != 'NOMER' then

 if :potential_duplicates.merge_flag = 'FALSE' and 
 (:for_s != 'F' or :for_p != 'F') then
 :potential_duplicates.merge_flag := '';
 show_error('16127'); /* invalid value for flag*/
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 if :potential_duplicates.merge_flag = 'FALSE' then
 :for_false := 'T';
 end if; 
 if :global.old_value = 'PRIMR' then
 :for_p := 'F';
 end if;
 
 if :global.old_value = 'SECON' then
 :for_s := 'F';
 end if;
 end if;

 if :potential_duplicates.merge_flag = 'PRIMR' and 
 (:for_FALSE != 'F' or :for_p != 'F') then
 :potential_duplicates.merge_flag := '';
 show_error('16127'); /* invalid value for flag*/
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 if :potential_duplicates.merge_flag = 'PRIMR' then
 :for_p := 'T';
 end if;
 if :global.old_value = 'PRIMR' then
 :for_p := 'F';
 end if;

 if :global.old_value = 'SECON' then
 :for_s := 'F';
 end if;

 end if;

 if :potential_duplicates.merge_flag = 'SECON' and 
 (:for_FALSE != 'F' or :for_s != 'F') then
 :potential_duplicates.merge_flag := '';
 show_error('16127'); /* invalid value for flag*/
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 else
 if :potential_duplicates.merge_flag = 'SECON' then
 :for_s := 'T';
 end if;
 if :global.old_value = 'PRIMR' then
 :for_p := 'F';
 end if;

 if :global.old_value = 'SECON' then
 :for_s := 'F';
 end if;

 end if;
else
 if :global.old_value = 'PRIMR' then
 :for_p := 'F';
 end if;

 if :global.old_value = 'SECON' then
 :for_s := 'F';
 end if;
 :for_false := 'F';

end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
Declare
 v_flag char(1);
BEGIN
 nullchk;check_package_failure;
-----
 IF :potential_duplicates.donor_id is not null then /* added by Edwin to check the duplicates */
 if nvl(:global.donor_id,' ')!=:potential_duplicates.donor_id then
 dup_check;
 end if;
 End if;
-------
 
 if (:potential_duplicates.donor_id is not null) then
 begin 
 select distinct nvl(intl_addr_flag,'N') 
 into v_flag 
 from donor_addresses
 where donor_id = :potential_duplicates.donor_id;
 exception 
 when no_data_found then v_flag := 'N';
 when others then handle_error;
 end;

 if v_flag = 'Y' then 
 select A.FIRST_NAME ||' '|| A.last_name ,
 A.DATE_OF_BIRTH,A.GENDER,
 b.intl_address_1||decode(b.intl_address_2,nvl(b.intl_address_2,0),',',null)||' '|| 
 b.intl_address_2||decode(b.intl_address_3,nvl(b.intl_address_3,0),',',null)||' '||
 b.intl_address_3||decode(b.intl_address_4,nvl(b.intl_address_4,0),',',null)||' '||
 b.intl_address_4||decode(b.country_name,nvl(b.country_name,0),',',null)||' '||
 b.COUNTRY_NAME||decode(b.intl_postal_code,nvl(b.intl_postal_code,0),',',null)||' '||b.INTL_POSTAL_CODE||' '||
 '(W) '||B.intl_work_phone_no||'-'||B.intl_work_phone_ext||
 ' (H) '|| B.intl_home_phone_no 
 into :potential_duplicates.donor_name,:potential_duplicates.S_DOB,
 :potential_duplicates.S_GENDER,
 :potential_duplicates.addr
 from donors a, donor_addresses b 
 where a.donor_id = :potential_duplicates.donor_id and
 a.donor_id = b.donor_id;
 
 
 else 
 select A.FIRST_NAME ||' '|| A.last_name ,
 A.DATE_OF_BIRTH,A.GENDER,
 B.STREET_NAME||' '||B.SUITE_APT||' '||
 c.city||' '||c.state||' '||c.zip||' '||
 '(W) '||B.D_AREA_CODE||'-'||B.D_PHONE_NO||' '||to_char(B.EXTENSION)||
 ' (H) '|| B.H_AREA_CODE ||'-'|| B.H_PHONE_NO 
 into :potential_duplicates.donor_name,:potential_duplicates.S_DOB,
 :potential_duplicates.S_GENDER,
 :potential_duplicates.addr
 from donors a, donor_addresses b, valid_city_state c
 where a.donor_id = :potential_duplicates.donor_id and
 a.donor_id = b.donor_id and
 b.usps_id = c.usps_id;
 
 end if;
 :potential_duplicates.name := :potential_duplicates.donor_name;
 end if;
 :merge_flag := 'NOMER';

exception
 when no_data_found then 
 show_error('18031');
 check_package_failure; 
END;

 A.DATE_OF_BIRTH,

 B.STREET_NAME || ' ' || B.SUITE_APT || ' ' || c.city || ' ' ||
 c.state || ' ' || c.zip || ' ' || '(W) ' || B.D_AREA_CODE || '-' ||
 B.D_PHONE_NO || ' ' || to_char(B.EXTENSION) || ' (H) ' ||
 B.H_AREA_CODE || '-' || B.H_PHONE_NO,
 b.intl_address_1 ||
 decode(b.intl_address_2, nvl(b.intl_address_2, 0), ',', null) || ' ' || --Logic added by ashraf
 b.intl_address_2 ||
 decode(b.intl_address_3, nvl(b.intl_address_3, 0), ',', null) || ' ' ||
 b.intl_address_3 ||
 decode(b.intl_address_4, nvl(b.intl_address_4, 0), ',', null) || ' ' ||
 b.intl_address_4 ||
 decode(country_name, nvl(country_name, 0), ',', null) || ' ' ||
 COUNTRY_NAME ||
 decode(b.intl_postal_code, nvl(b.intl_postal_code, 0), ',', null) || ' ' ||
 b.INTL_POSTAL_CODE intl_address,
 '(W) ' || b.intl_work_phone_no || ' ' || b.intl_work_phone_ext ||
 ' (H) ' || b.intl_home_phone_no intl_phone_string,
 b.intl_addr_flag
 into :potential_duplicates.donor_name,
 :potential_duplicates.S_DOB,
 :potential_duplicates.S_GENDER,
 :potential_duplicates.addr,
 lv_intl_address,
 lv_intl_phone_string,
 lv_intl_addr_flag
 from donors a, donor_addresses b, valid_city_state c
 where a.donor_id = :potential_duplicates.donor_id
 and a.donor_id = b.donor_id
 and b.usps_id = c.usps_id(+);
 
 if NVL(lv_intl_addr_flag, 'N') = 'Y' then
 :potential_duplicates.addr := lv_intl_address || ' ' || lv_intl_phone_string;
 end if;

 :potential_duplicates.name :=
 :potential_duplicates.donor_name || '''' || 'S';

 if :potential_duplicates.demographics_user is not null then
 Select substr(user_first_name, 1, 1) || '.' || initcap(USER_LAST_NAME)
 into :potential_duplicates.dm_user
 from system_users
 where user_id = :potential_duplicates.demographics_user;
 end if;

 if :potential_duplicates.interdictions_user is not null then
 Select substr(user_first_name, 1, 1) || '.' || initcap(USER_LAST_NAME)
 into :potential_duplicates.i_user
 from system_users
 where user_id = :potential_duplicates.interdictions_user;
 end if;

 if :potential_duplicates.keydata_user is not null then
 Select substr(user_first_name, 1, 1) || '.' || initcap(USER_LAST_NAME)
 into :potential_duplicates.k_user
 from system_users
 where user_id = :potential_duplicates.keydata_user;
 end if;
 if :potential_duplicates.donations_user is not null then
 Select substr(user_first_name, 1, 1) || '.' || initcap(USER_LAST_NAME)
 into :potential_duplicates.dn_user
 from system_users
 where user_id = :potential_duplicates.donations_user;
 end if;

 if :potential_duplicates.attributes_user is not null then
 Select substr(user_first_name, 1, 1) || '.' || initcap(USER_LAST_NAME)
 into :potential_duplicates.A_user
 from system_users
 where user_id = :potential_duplicates.attributes_user;
 end if;

 if :potential_duplicates.set_status_code = 'RESOL' then
 :ctrl_block_1.set_status_code := 'RESOL';
 set_block_property('potential_duplicates',
 UPDATE_ALLOWED,
 property_false);
 else
 set_block_property('potential_duplicates',
 UPDATE_ALLOWED,
 property_TRUE);
 end if;

 if :potential_duplicates.merge_flag = 'FALSE' then
 :ctrl_block_1.flag := 'F';
 :ctrl_block_1.for_false := 'T';
 end if;

 if :potential_duplicates.merge_flag in ('PRIMR', 'SECON') then
 :ctrl_block_1.flag := 'P';
 end if;
 if :potential_duplicates.merge_flag = 'PRIMR' then
 :ctrl_block_1.for_p := 'T';
 end if;

 if :potential_duplicates.merge_flag = 'SECON' then
 :ctrl_block_1.for_s := 'T';
 end if;

 if :potential_duplicates.set_status_code = 'PENDG' then
 :global.status := 'PENDG';
 end if;
 if :potential_duplicates.set_status_code = 'FALSE' then
 :global.status := 'FALSE';
 end if;

EXCEPTION
 when no_data_found then
 :potential_duplicates.donor_name := 'Not found';
 :potential_duplicates.S_DOB := '';
 :potential_duplicates.S_GENDER := '';
 :potential_duplicates.addr := '';
 when OTHERS then
 message(sqlerrm);
 check_package_failure;
END;

PROCEDURE dup_check IS
 check_dup number;
 temp number;

BEGIN
 :global.frm_status:='S';
 
/* Check in the database */

 select count(*) into temp from potential_duplicates where
 set_id=:potential_duplicates.set_id and donor_id=:potential_duplicates.donor_id;

 if temp > 0 then
 show_error('16106');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;

/* check in the buffer */

 
 if nvl(:global.donor_id,' ') != nvl(:potential_duplicates.donor_id,' ') then
 check_insert_rg('invest_rg0','C10C10',:global.set_id||','
 ||:global.donor_id||',','D',check_dup); 
 end if;

 check_insert_rg('invest_rg0','C10C10',:potential_duplicates.set_id||','
 ||:potential_duplicates.donor_id||',','C',check_dup);

 if check_dup = 1 then
 show_error('16106');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 check_insert_rg('invest_rg0','C10C10',:potential_duplicates.set_id||','
 ||:potential_duplicates.donor_id||',','U',check_dup);
 
 end if;

END;

declare
 msg number;
begin
 select count(msg_id)
 into msg
 from alert_log
 where user_id = LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid
 and read_date is null;
 
 if msg > 0 then
 set_item_property('toolbar.pb_alerts',label,'Msg: '||to_char(msg));
 end if;
exception
 when program_error then
 null; 
end;

 item_change('ctrl_block_1.set_id','E');

 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_demo',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_key',enabled,property_true);

 set_item_property('ctrl_block_1.pb_inter',enabled,property_true);
 :ctrl_block_1.set_id := :potential_duplicates.set_id;
 show_error('9163');
 check_package_failure;
else
 rollback;
end if;
end if;
